title: Diverse sizes... gets the job done
text: Diverse sizes... gets the job done. I was looking for something to wash my bra's and this were appealing, if you wear anything larger than a C cup however, it is hard to get them into the smaller circular bags. The bags also dont' really let out any dirt because of the thickness. They still get them cleaned, but not as well as other products I have used.
